result.narrative:
Boeing presents as a large, financially substantial buyer under operational strain rather than financial distress. The payment file is clean — zero DPD, no open overdue notifications, and a single historical event (a $650k invoice resolved 3 days late in June 2026) from one policyholder. Against that, the recent news flow is dominated by workforce and production problems: a confirmed cut of 5% of commercial airplane workers, an open-ended statement that further layoffs are possible, 737 Max ramp-up deferred to late 2027, Max 10 certification delayed and a Transportation Department watchdog audit of FAA oversight. Offsetting that, the order book stands at $745B, the $20B F/A-XX Navy award is now uncontested and a $12B aircraft sale has been announced.

The score of 27.8 sits in Watch and is produced entirely by the news leg: 0.65 x 0.0 (payment, 0 DPD) + 0.35 x 79.5 (news) = 27.8. The driver is the severity 4 layoffs article of 20 November. The adjudicator agreed with caveats and the caveats matter here. First, the driving article is speculative and body-less — it says only that Boeing "leaves open the possibility" of more layoffs, yet is scored the same severity as the confirmed cut. Second, the 0.0 payment input carries 65% of the weight but rests on a file the payment review itself marks "insufficient_history", so it is closer to an absence of data than to demonstrated good behaviour. Third, the positive evidence — backlog, Navy award, aircraft sale, FAA clearance of the Max software glitch — all scores 0.0 and cannot offset anything. The adjudicator nevertheless judged the band robust: the next-ranked item, the confirmed 5% workforce cut, decays to 77.9, only marginally below the 79.5 used, so stripping out the speculative headline would not move Boeing out of Watch.

The recommendation is to MAINTAIN the single TCI export line at $9,000,000, with no change, on the basis that PD of 0.1784 is inside the 0.25 appetite threshold and maximum liability does not bind. Expected loss is unchanged at $1,156,032 before and after. Given the thinness of the payment file behind the clean 0 DPD input, the sensible condition on maintaining is active monitoring rather than reliance on the score: the exposure is approved on appetite, not on a demonstrated payment track record.

Boeing is 7.8 points from Healthy at 20.0. With the payment leg already at zero, the only route down is news decay — the severity 4 layoffs items age out on a 365-day half-life, so the band will not improve quickly without the adverse flow stopping. Confirmation that the 5% cut is the end of the workforce reduction, a resumption of the 737 Max ramp-up ahead of the late-2027 guidance, or closure of the Max 10 certification and FAA oversight audit would each remove a live negative theme. Deterioration would need 22.2 points, equivalent to 33 DPD, or a fresh severity 5 event.
